questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how these endpoints map operations onto HTTP methods and resources? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client sends DELETE /campaigns/:id twice for the same existing campaign. What responses does it get?
choices: 204 then 404, because the second archive call can't find a non-archived campaign
404 then 404, because archive never removes the row from the map
204 then 409, because the campaign is already archived

questions.prompt: After a campaign is archived via DELETE, which call still returns it?
choices: None of these; archived campaigns are filtered out everywhere these routes read them

questions.prompt: What does the POST that creates a campaign tell the client about the new resource?
choices: 201 with a Location header pointing at /campaigns/{id} and the campaign body
